tasks.title: ProjectUpdates model
tasks.description: Create `ProjectUpdate` collection and Mongoose model to record progress updates, delays and QA notes.
tasks.completionCriteria: Model schema implemented, migrations/seed optional, index on projectId created, unit tests for validation present

tasks.title: SiteVisitReports model
tasks.description: Create `SiteVisitReport` collection and model for inspector visit records including photos, geoLocation and issues.
tasks.completionCriteria: Model implemented with indexes; photo refs stored as ObjectId; schema validation enforced

tasks.title: MonitoringReports cache model
tasks.description: Create `MonitoringReport` schema to store weekly aggregated metrics for fast dashboard queries.
tasks.completionCriteria: Model implemented; scheduled job can write and read aggregates; TTL index optional

tasks.title: Monitoring routes and controller scaffolding
tasks.description: Add `monitoring.routes.ts` and `monitoring.controller.ts` with endpoint skeletons for summary, list, create update and site-visit APIs.
tasks.completionCriteria: Routes registered in index; endpoints authenticate and return stubbed responses; integration tests can call endpoints

tasks.title: Create ProjectUpdate controller logic
tasks.description: Implement create/read for ProjectUpdates with validation, ObjectId conversion and audit logging.
tasks.completionCriteria: Create and list operations persist correct documents; audit logs created for create/update actions

tasks.title: SiteVisitReport endpoints
tasks.description: Implement POST/GET for inspector site visits, photo references, geoLocation and issues.
tasks.completionCriteria: Site visit creation validates inspector role and stores photos as `DesignFile` refs; GET returns list and detail

tasks.title: Monitoring summary and metrics endpoints
tasks.description: Implement summary endpoints that read MonitoringReports or compute aggregates on demand.
tasks.completionCriteria: Summary endpoints return KPIs used by frontend dashboard with pagination and filters

tasks.title: Validation & Audit logging
tasks.description: Add strong request validation (ObjectId checks, required fields, ranges) and hook audit log creation for key operations.
tasks.completionCriteria: Requests with invalid payloads return 400; audit log entries present for create/update/delete operations

tasks.title: Background scheduler for monitoring aggregates
tasks.description: Implement scheduled job to compute weekly MonitoringReports and push to cache collection.
tasks.completionCriteria: Job runs locally and populates MonitoringReports; endpoints serve cached metrics

tasks.title: Monitoring Dashboard page
tasks.description: Create dashboard showing KPIs: Projects Under Monitoring, Delayed Projects, Weekly Site Visits, Completion Requests.
tasks.completionCriteria: Dashboard fetches summary endpoint and displays KPIs; responsive layout passes visual review

tasks.title: Monitoring list (projects under monitoring)
tasks.description: Implement paginated list with filters and search for monitored projects.
tasks.completionCriteria: List queries backend with filters; clicking a row navigates to detail page

tasks.title: Monitoring detail / project timeline
tasks.description: Project detail page with ProjectTimeline and last SiteVisitReports and ProjectUpdates.
tasks.completionCriteria: Detail page shows timeline, photos, and ability to add a progress update (form present)

tasks.title: Progress update form & photo upload
tasks.description: Form to submit `ProjectUpdate` with percentComplete, notes and photo uploads; client-side validation.
tasks.completionCriteria: Form validates locally and submits to backend; uploaded photos show previews

tasks.title: Site Visit Reports UI
tasks.description: Inspector visit reporting screens (create + view) mobile-first.
tasks.completionCriteria: Inspector can submit a visit report with photos and geoLocation; reports are listed in project detail

tasks.title: Delay & Quality tracking components
tasks.description: UI widgets to flag delays and run QA checks, with status badges and filtering.
tasks.completionCriteria: Delays can be recorded and filtered; QA statuses display correctly

tasks.title: End-to-end monitoring flow
tasks.description: Integrate backend and frontend flows: create update → visit → aggregate → dashboard reflects changes.
tasks.completionCriteria: Smoke test demonstrates E2E flow for a test project (tools/testing/smoke_test.js updated accordingly)

tasks.title: Unit tests and validation tests
tasks.description: Add unit tests for models and controller validation rules.
tasks.completionCriteria: Unit tests covering validation and key controller behavior pass in CI

tasks.title: Runtime / smoke tests
tasks.description: Extend `tools/testing/smoke_test.js` to include monitoring flows and assert KPIs.
tasks.completionCriteria: Smoke tests pass end-to-end in local dev environment

roadmap.notes: Estimates assume a single developer; adjust for team size. Include buffer for reviews and QA.
